identity: exact trimmed key or URL; no automatic merge
required_columns: exactly one key header matching the selected mode
header_rules: ignore case; spaces/hyphens map to underscores; duplicate aliases or mixed key types rejected
counts: safe nonnegative ungrouped integers; clicks <= impressions
position: optional finite positive number; never averaged across duplicates
derived_ctr: clicks/impressions only when impressions > 0 and counts valid
identical_rows: may collapse with notice; no metric sums or position averages
position_delta: after minus before; lower is better

decomposition.preconditions: both periods valid counts and impressions > 0
decomposition.conservation: sum equals click delta within exported floating-point tolerance

coverage: export top-row limits and anonymized/omitted queries; not property totals
